text_block_list.text:
The new year had arrived. Starting this year,
Nakayama Festa is also in the Senior Year.

Right at the start of the New Year,
I met up with Nakayama Festa and the others.
And where we headed was—
(Pshhh-khooo...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, your suitcase isn't anywhere in sight.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, hotel check-in time is closing in!
What are we gonna do, Trainer?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, alrighty then, let's stop here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoops, see, unexpected things are par for the course at airports! Never forget the spirit of cool!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still though, what was it, VR Umalator?
To think it can even recreate the airport over there.
The sound and the sensation are so real, too...
On this day, we used the Academy's facility, the "VR Umalator," to run a simulation of arriving at the venue.
choice_data_list: Knowing about something and actually experiencing it are completely different
Knowing about something and actually experiencing it are completely different, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That's why we're doing a dry run!
Let's get totally used to it while we still can!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now, I'll input the next data into the machine.
Could the three of you step into
the Umalator once more?
choice_data_list: Thank you for helping out too.
Thank you for helping out too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No. Not at all.
Now then, let's move on to the next video.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! The 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' from when El ran!
It's been reproduced magnificently~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Your interest is skyrocketing!
Shall we go walk the course for real, then?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So this is French turf.
The feel is completely different...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It feels a bit like the turf we used to run on back in my freestyle days.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because France is skilled at making courses
that make the best use of the natural terrain, yes.
choice_data_list: The turf really is different from the ground up, huh...
The turf really is different from the ground up, isn't it...

text_block_list.text:
Taking a step forward, my feet sink deep into the ground.
It feels soft, yet wraps around me as if entangling my legs—
choice_data_list: (…Training on the academy's turf won't be enough to prepare for this.)

text_block_list.text: I realized that I had harbored an unconscious complacency, assuming that as long as I trained in the well-equipped environment of Tracen Academy, everything would be fine.
If you are going to take on an away challenge abroad, you must understand the local conditions and hungrily adapt to their environment as a challenger.
choice_data_list: (I need to come up with a different training plan...)

text_block_list.text:
The experience El Condor Pasa shared with me
was something I never could have gained as a rookie.
"I wonder how much information we can actually absorb in the time given to us."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on!
So, which training should we start with?
choice_data_list: I'd like to know about good food spots nearby.
Can we do some parallel running here?
I'd like to take a little walk around the area.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, nice perspective!
Food is su~per important, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can eat delicious food,
I'm totally happy!
If it tastes bad, I'll cry, desu...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a racetrack, so wouldn't
the food culture be pretty advanced too?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
B-But they don't serve your favorite
motsu stew here, Nakayama-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I know at least that much.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Paris itself has lots and lots of
delicious food, you know!
I'll teach you all about them!

And so, we looked around the city streets near the racetrack,
the hotels, and the food stalls, checking out all things food-related—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Claro! Since we're doing this,
let's call over an opponent too!
Grass~! Pretty please~!
(Boom!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, look who it is—Sirius.
Rocking that grumpy face again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, she's quiet.
Normally, that girl would be complaining
up a storm right about now."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I had Grass set it up that way for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A chatty Sirius-senpai
...is kind of a pain, desu.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ahaha, what's with that, El?
That's quite an unexpected weakness to confess.

And after enjoying the French turf
for just a brief moment—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, true enough.
Let's start by taking a look around.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood, YES! Better a familiar road than an unfamiliar one!
Allow me to guide you to the waiting room while we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wait, they don't have a dirt course here? The whole setup's totally different from Japan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Show me what's inside too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geh?! N-Nakayama-senpai?!
Please don't run off on your own!!
"Perhaps due to the novelty of it all, Nakayama Festa's excitement seems to be rising as well."
In unfamiliar places, people sometimes act differently than usual. Perhaps that applies even to her, composed as she always is.
And so, after taking a detailed look around the racetrack for a while—
(Pshhh-khooo...)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Great work, everyone~.
choice_data_list: Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am so totally exhausted desu!
Grass, let's go drink some amazake~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds lovely.
Mind if I join you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, it looks like everyone could use some sugar.
Oh, Trainer, would you like some too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maybe we could all go make a wish together just like this... or something.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! There are so many food stalls, desu!
Hot dogs and cotton candy! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah, El! ...Honestly.
choice_data_list: She's full of energy, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. El is a very honest and straightforward girl.
And because of that, she has a strong core...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Nakayama-senpai, Trainer.
I have one request for you both.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El is truly trying to entrust this to you all. That is precisely why she is training you with everything she has.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
She may sometimes deliver the harsh truth without sugarcoating it.
Even so, please be sure to listen to her.
It comes not from malice, but from hope.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.
